items.info: Overhead Panel. Left and right IRS ON. The GPS position fills in on the POS INIT page by itself.

items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers the flight deck door.

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the emergency lighting system.

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON.

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turns on navigation lights.
items.label: NAV Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the tail logo, usually required at night.
items.label: Logo Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Primary L and R ON.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify no OFF light illuminated on L1, L2, R1, R2.
items.label: Generator Controls

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify no fault.

items.label: Recirc Fans

items.label: Trim Air

items.info: Overhead Panel. AUTO.

items.info: Overhead Panel. AUTO.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects the left and right fuel manifolds.
items.label: Fuel Crossfeed

items.info: Overhead Panel. FWD & AFT outflow valves AUTO, landing altitude selector pushed in.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Overhead Panel. Tests the fire and overheat detection. Fire warnings show on EICAS during the test and clear when it ends.
items.label: Fire/Overheat Test

items.info: CDU. IDENT, POS INIT, RTE (origin, destination, flight number, route), DEP/ARR, LEGS (delete discontinuities). Back on the RTE page press ACTIVATE, then EXEC: the header reads ACT RTE 1 and the route turns magenta on the ND. Then ALTN, PERF INIT (ZFW, reserves, CRZ ALT, cost index), THRUST LIM and TAKEOFF (flaps, CG, then V1, VR and V2 from the REF column). Forecast winds on the VNAV CLB and DES pages are optional. EXEC after each change.
items.label: FMC Preflight

items.info: EICAS. Verify EICAS fuel quantity matches expected load.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set per FMC takeoff data. Verify on EICAS.
items.label: Stab Trim

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify zero on EICAS.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: MCP. Both CPT and FO flight directors ON.
items.label: Flight Directors

items.info: MCP. Arms the autothrottle system for takeoff.
items.label: A/T

items.info: PFD Control Panel, glareshield. Set local QNH. Cross-check standby instrument.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: MCP. Speed window at V2 from the CDU TAKEOFF page. Heading window at the runway heading. Altitude window at the initial cleared altitude, which VNAV climbs to after takeoff.
items.label: MCP Bugs

items.info: Main Panel. Arms the autobrake system for a rejected takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Enter the assigned squawk on a tuning control panel. Mode knob, between the two panels, at STBY.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Main Panel. Verify gear lever DOWN, EICAS shows DOWN.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify speed brake lever is in the DOWN detent.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify IDLE, reversers stowed.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify both fuel control switches CUTOFF before start.
items.label: Fuel Control

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set to agree with actual flap position.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Main Panel. Cross-check standby attitude and heading indicators.
items.label: Standby Instruments

items.info: EICAS. Verify on SYS/DOOR page — all doors closed and armed.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Overhead Panel. FWD L and R and AFT EXT PWR switches OFF once the APU generators carry the load (ELEC page on the SYS display). It may already have disconnected by itself.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Required before engine start.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Cockpit. Review departure procedures, speeds, and emergency plans.
items.label: Takeoff Briefing

items.info: Center Pedestal, left of the throttles. Push down and forward to release before pushback.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Exterior. Initiate pushback sequence.
items.label: Pushback

items.info: Center Pedestal, behind the throttles. Set to RUN before turning the start selector. The right engine starts first.
items.label: R Fuel Control

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn to START. AUTOSTART shows above the N2 gauge on EICAS and changes to RUNNING when the engine is ready.
items.label: R Start Selector

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set to RUN before turning the left start selector.
items.label: L Fuel Control

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn to START. Watch AUTOSTART change to RUNNING above the N2 gauge.
items.label: L Start Selector

items.info: Main Panel. Verify both engines stable — normal N1, N2, EGT, oil pressure.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Center Pedestal, left of the throttles. Set once pushback is complete and the engines are running.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify both return to NORM.
items.label: Start Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. L and R primary pumps ON once the engines are running. Verify no FAULT light.
items.label: Hyd Primary Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Electric pumps, off until the engines are running. Verify no FAULT.
items.label: Hyd C1 & C2 Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. L and R demand pumps, off until the engines are running. Verify no FAULT.
items.label: Hyd Demand Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify L1, L2, R1, R2 — no OFF light.
items.label: Generators

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shut down APU.
items.label: APU

items.info: Center Pedestal, mode knob between the two tuning control panels. Enter the assigned squawk if not already set.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Cockpit. Full and free movement — verify on SYS/FCTL page.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set the takeoff flaps entered on the CDU TAKEOFF page, such as flaps 10.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on engine or wing anti-ice if icing conditions exist.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Main Panel. Verify no hidden alerts.
items.label: Recall

items.info: Overhead Panel. Forward-facing ground light for taxiway visibility.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the sides of the taxiway for better visibility in turns.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. Release to begin taxi.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Test brakes and steering during initial taxi. Max 30 kts straight, 10 kts in turns.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: PFD. Cross-check heading, attitude, altimeter during taxi.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: MCP. Verify V2 in MCP speed window. Cross-check flap setting and thrust selection.
items.label: CDU Speeds

items.info: EICAS. Verify set for takeoff.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal, mode knob between the two tuning control panels. TA/RA.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turns on main landing lights before entering the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off at lineup.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: ND Control Panel, glareshield. Turn on weather radar (WXR) to monitor conditions ahead.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: ND Control Panel, glareshield. Turn on terrain display (TERR) for situational awareness.
items.label: Terrain Display

items.info: Overhead Panel. Lower the HUD combiner glass into the deployed position before entering the runway.
items.label: HUD

items.info: MCP. Arm VNAV for the climb to the MCP altitude. Arm LNAV too when flying a departure procedure; leave it off when ATC assigns a heading. The PFD should show TO/GA for roll and pitch.
items.label: LNAV / VNAV

items.info: PFD. Confirm V1, VR, V2 — cross-check MCP speed.
items.label: Takeoff Data

items.info: EICAS. Verify normal indications before advancing throttles.
items.label: Engine Instruments

items.info: Center Pedestal. Advance both throttles to 30% TPR and check the engines are stable.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Center Pedestal. Move both levers to the green carrot on the TPR gauge before pressing TOGA. At 80 kt the autothrottle goes to HOLD and hands the levers back, and a hardware throttle left behind would change the thrust.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Throttles, or the AUTO THROTTLE TO GA key binding. Press once before 50 kt. The autothrottle sets takeoff thrust and the PFD shows THR REF, then HOLD at 80 kt.
items.label: TOGA

items.info: Yoke. Rotate at the VR speed shown on the PFD and follow the flight director. The autopilot can go on after 50 ft AGL.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main Panel. Retract at positive rate of climb.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract in steps as the speed passes each flap marker on the PFD speed tape.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: MCP. Engage at your discretion after 50 ft AGL.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: MCP, heading knob. Press SEL after 1,500 ft to hold the runway heading when departing on a heading.
items.label: HDG SEL

items.info: MCP. Once level at the initial altitude, press LNAV. To join the route, on the CDU LEGS page press the left key next to the first waypoint twice, then EXEC. The PFD shows LNAV as the roll mode and the aircraft turns onto the route.
items.label: LNAV

items.info: MCP. Set the cruise altitude from PERF INIT, then press the altitude knob once to start the climb. The PFD shows VNAV SPD and THR REF.
items.label: MCP Altitude

items.info: Overhead Panel. AUTO if icing conditions.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Main Panel. Disarm after successful takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Raise the HUD combiner glass into the stowed position once airborne and established in the climb.
items.label: HUD

items.info: Center Pedestal, mode knob between the two tuning control panels. Verify mode.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Overhead Panel. Passing 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Passing 10,000 ft.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: PFD Control Panel, glareshield. Set standard at transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: PFD Control Panel, glareshield. Verify set to STD (29.92 / 1013).
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign off during smooth cruise.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: EICAS. Monitor fuel burn vs. flight plan.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: COMM Radio. Obtain current weather and runway information for arrival.
items.label: ATIS

items.info: CDU, APPROACH REF page. Pick the landing flap setting (20, 25 or 30) and copy its VREF into the FLAP/SPEED line. This puts VREF on the PFD. Verify ILS frequency on RADNAV page.
items.label: FMC Approach

items.info: Main Panel. Select appropriate setting for runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: PFD Control Panel, glareshield. BARO for manual landing, RADIO for autoland or low-vis.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: MCP. About 10 nm before top of descent (TO T/D on the VNAV CRZ page), set the lowest altitude on the arrival or your cleared altitude. VNAV only descends once the MCP altitude is below cruise.
items.label: MCP Altitude

items.info: MCP. Set runway heading for missed approach.
items.label: Heading Bug

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON for descent.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Main Panel. Check for any system alerts on the EICAS.
items.label: Recall

items.info: PFD Control Panel, glareshield. Set local barometric at transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Enhances visibility when approaching the terminal area.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: PFD speed tape. Below 10,000 ft the FMS target speed should be under 240 kt. Use the speed brake lever on the Center Pedestal to slow down if needed.
items.label: Speed

items.info: PFD. Verify set to local QNH.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Verify set.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: MCP, speed knob. Press the knob to open the speed window, then set 220 kt. The PFD shows the selected speed in magenta.
items.label: MCP Speed

items.info: Center Pedestal. Flaps 5 is good to 240 kt, so set it once slowing to 220 kt.
items.label: Flaps 5

items.info: MCP. Set the approach altitudes in steps below the lowest arrival altitude, down to the altitude for the final approach fix.
items.label: MCP Altitude

items.info: MCP. Press VS/FPA and set -800 ft/min with the V/S knob for each step down. The aircraft levels at the MCP altitude, below the glideslope.
items.label: V/S

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arm the speed brakes for automatic deployment upon landing.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: MCP. Press APP about 1 nm before the first approach fix, on an intercept heading. A direct-to that fix on the CDU LEGS page turns the aircraft onto one. The PFD shows LOC active and G/S armed in white.
items.label: APP Mode

items.info: MCP, speed knob. Set 180 kt once the localizer is captured.
items.label: MCP Speed

items.info: Center Pedestal. After slowing to 180 kt.
items.label: Flaps 15

items.info: MCP. Once the glideslope is captured, set the missed approach altitude from the approach chart, so the autopilot climbs to it on a go-around.
items.label: Missed Approach Alt

items.info: MCP, speed knob. Approaching the final approach fix, set VREF + 5. VREF shows on the PFD from the APPROACH REF page.
items.label: MCP Speed

items.info: Main Panel. Down by 2,500 ft AGL. EICAS shows DOWN.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set the landing flaps chosen on the APPROACH REF page, such as flaps 30, with the gear down.
items.label: Landing Flaps

items.info: Main Panel. Verify landing gear is down and locked.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify speed brakes are armed.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: MCP. Disconnect at minimums. Leave engaged for CAT III autoland.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: MCP A/T arm switches, or the disconnect button on the throttles. Disconnect during the flare and bring the throttles to idle.
items.label: A/T

items.info: Center Pedestal. Deploy after touchdown. Reverse IDLE by 60 kts.
items.label: Thrust Reversers

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Manual braking at ~40 kts disengages autobrake.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Main Panel. Turn off the autobrake system.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract all flaps.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract the speed brakes.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: MCP. L and R autothrottle arm switches OFF.
items.label: A/T Arm

items.info: Overhead Panel. Start it while taxiing in so it can take the electrical load at shutdown.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off after clearing the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off after clearing the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Before entering gate.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Keep on for better visibility during tight turns.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal, mode knob between the two tuning control panels. Set to STBY to stop transmitting.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: ND Control Panel, glareshield. Off on the ground.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Overhead Panel. Before entering gate.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set parking brake once aligned at the gate.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Both fuel control switches to CUTOFF.
items.label: Fuel Control

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off after engines have completely spooled down.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connect GPU before shutting down APU.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign OFF.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off electric motor pumps.
items.label: Hyd EMPs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off all fuel pumps.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: MCP. Turn off flight directors.
items.label: Flight Directors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure all anti-ice systems are off.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off inertial reference systems.
items.label: IRS Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off air conditioning packs.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off recirculation fans.
items.label: Recirc Fans

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off window heating.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off navigation lights.
items.label: NAV Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off once external power is connected.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disarm emergency lights.
items.label: Emergency Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Last switch — aircraft fully de-powered.
items.label: Battery
